summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Theme Toggle feature (Ivory & Ink light theme ↔ Neon Shadow dark theme). All functionality working perfectly: toggle buttons on Login page (pre-auth) and GameHud (post-auth) successfully switch themes, CSS variables flip correctly, localStorage persists theme choice across reloads and navigation, all 9 pages tested in dark mode show proper text readability and card contrast with no white boxes or visual issues, Sonner toasts render legibly in both themes, and zero console errors detected.
passed_tests: Login page theme toggle (pre-auth): Moon/Sun icon flip, glass panel color change from light ivory to dark navy
GameHud theme toggle (post-auth): Moon/Sun icon flip, body background change from rgb(244,238,226) to rgb(5,5,10), heading text color change from rgb(36,28,51) to rgb(255,255,255)
Dark theme navigation: All 9 pages (BattleHub, Campaign, Dungeons, Shop, Forge, TeamBuilder, Gallery, Arena, Spire) maintain dark theme with readable text and distinct card surfaces
Toggle back to light: Successfully returns to original Ivory & Ink theme with no regression
LocalStorage persistence: Theme choice stored as 'sc_theme' and persists across page reloads and navigation
Sonner toast legibility: 'Welcome, shinobi!' toast verified readable in both light and dark themes
Console errors: Zero application errors (only expected 401 on initial /api/auth/me before login, and external Cloudflare RUM requests)
